description: A postmarketOS phone's desktop window (pmos.rs, PmosDesktop.tsx): the app's own page, which shows the phone's video and sends it the mouse and keyboard. It logs, goes full screen with F11, and closes itself. The clipboard is this page's to share with the phone, by its own rules (clipboardShare.ts), and the store keeps the switch for it; files dropped on it go to the phone through pmos.rs.
